title: Eggs with avo, tomato and spinach
steps: To poach the eggs, bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer, crack each egg into a cup and slip it in. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the white is set, then lift out with a slotted spoon. Or boil them for 7 to 9 minutes.
Slice the avo and tomato and arrange them on a plate with the spinach.
Add the eggs and season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
